lines.text: Many learners say: I go often to the market.
Better: I often go to the market.
Often walks! She often walks to school.

data.wrong: I go often to the market.
data.right: I often go to the market.

native.tip: Trạng từ tần suất như “often” đứng trước động từ thường: “I often go”, giống “tôi thường đi chợ.”
native.caption: Bạn có hay nói “I go often to the market.” không? 🛒 “Often” đứng trước động từ: “I often go to the market.” Nghe cô Ama đọc rồi lặp lại nhé! Luyện thêm trong app Lexkite.
native.comment: Đáp án: “often walks.” Kể một việc bạn hay làm bằng “I often…” nhé! Luyện thêm miễn phí tại đây: {link}

en.tip: Frequency words like “often” go before the main verb, as in “I often go.”
en.caption: Do you often say this? “I go often to the market.” Say “I often go to the market.” instead. Listen to Ama, then repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
